title: Batch of issues for cmd/factory (batch.json)
description: The issues one factory run works on. An issue is a ticket only if it carries the command that decides whether it is done: precheck marks one without it `skipped` and spends nothing, so an empty done_command is a valid document and an invalid ticket. Issue ids must be unique within the batch (checked by cmd/factory).

id.description: Becomes part of the lane's slice id and branch.

body.description: The issue text, passed to the builder as the goal.

done_command.description: The command that decides the issue is done. Empty = not a ticket.
